original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳少年在美国遭枪杀，其母赴美奔丧并要求伸张正义
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一名15岁加纳少年Javits Frimpong上周四在纽约布朗克斯上学途中被追截并遭枪击身亡。其母亲Doris Adu Gyamfi获美国总统特朗普批准紧急签证后已离开加纳赴美，表示要为儿子讨回公道。警方尚未逮捕任何人，正在追捕三名涉案青少年嫌疑人，调查仍在进行中。加纳政府谴责这起枪击事件，并敦促美方彻查。

location.raw_text: Ghana (mother's departure); shooting occurred in the Bronx, New York, United States

key_facts.fact: 一名15岁加纳少年Javits Frimpong在纽约布朗克斯上学途中被追截并遭枪击身亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Her son, Javits Frimpong, who had only been in the US for a year, was chased down and shot on Thursday morning on his way to school in the Bronx, New York.

key_facts.fact: 警方尚未逮捕任何人，正在追捕三名涉案青少年嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Police have not made any arrests and an investigation is ongoing as authorities search for three teenage boys in connection with the shooting.

key_facts.fact: 死者母亲Doris Adu Gyamfi获特朗普批准紧急签证后离开加纳赴美
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The mother of a 15-year-old Ghanaian boy who was fatally shot in the United States last week has left Ghana for America after being granted an emergency visa by President Donald Trump.

key_facts.fact: 加纳政府谴责这起枪击事件并要求美方彻查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ghana's government has condemned the killing and said it was following the case closely to ensure justice.

uncertainties: 三名青少年嫌疑人身份及作案动机尚未确认
案件调查仍在进行，尚无人员被捕
目前仅单一来源（BBC）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
